def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3
            + t*(p[4]*P+p[5]*P**2+p[6]*P**3)
            + t**2*(p[7]*P+p[8]*P**2+p[9]*P**3))
